Application Data.NAME: Green Golf Gear Inc.
Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF OPERATIONS: Green Golf Gear Inc. is a retail establishment specializing in the sale of high-quality golf equipment, including clubs, balls, apparel, and accessories. Our store is dedicated to providing customers with knowledgeable service and top-notch products to enhance their golfing experience. We maintain a secure location equipped with a professionally monitored alarm system, ensuring the safety of our inventory. Our premises are well-maintained with clear safety protocols in place to minimize the risk of slip-and-fall incidents. Additionally, we focus solely on the sale of new golfing equipment and do not engage in any rental operations or the sale of firearms or ammunition, aligning with preferred underwriting guidelines.

Application Data.DESCRIPTION OF LOSSES: On March 15, 2023, Green Golf Gear Inc. experienced a theft incident where $3,000 worth of golf clubs were stolen from the premises due to a break-in. The alarm system was activated, and the police were notified. The claim is currently under investigation with the insurer. Additionally, on July 22, 2022, there was a minor slip-and-fall incident leading to a claim of $2,000, which has been settled and is now closed.
Application Data.HOURS OF OPERATION: Monday to Saturday: 9:00 AM - 8:00 PM; Sunday: 10:00 AM - 6:00 PM
Application Data.SAFE/VAULT DETAILS: Class B, Grade 1 Safe, UL Listed for cash and securities storage.
Application Data.OTHER PROTECTION: Professional monitoring of alarm system, security fencing around the perimeter, and security personnel on-site during business hours.
